notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description:
Where to send which messages? Nothing is sent without a target. "Send test message" checks the targets right away.

Webhook for Paperless-ngx (workflow action "Webhook", method POST, JSON): `{webhook_url}`

data_description.notify_services: e.g. mobile_app_iphone_ludger. Several are possible; "Benachrichtigung in Home Assistant" shows in the sidebar.
data_description.paperless_webhook_id: Letters, digits, _ and - only. Do not reuse the ID of an existing automation that is still switched on.

buttons.title: External buttons
buttons.description:
A button or remote can start scans. There are two ways, enter only one:

• **MQTT topic** (recommended for Zigbee2MQTT, no change to Zigbee2MQTT needed): `zigbee2mqtt/<device name>/action`, e.g. `zigbee2mqtt/Ikea Fernbedienung/action`.
• **Entity** that reports the presses (ZHA, Matter, or Zigbee2MQTT with event entities enabled).

Leave both empty and save to switch the feature off.

data_description.button_topic: Exactly as in Zigbee2MQTT, with the device name (no wildcards # or +).

button_actions.title: Assign the buttons

data_description.adf: Two-sided or one-sided, depending on the "Feeder two-sided (buttons)" switch.
data_description.toggle_duplex: Flips the "Feeder two-sided (buttons)" switch, e.g. on a long press.

error.duplicate_button_value: A value can only be assigned to one action
error.no_button_mapping: Assign at least one button (or leave the entity empty to switch the feature off)
error.button_source_both: Please enter only one source: entity or MQTT topic
error.invalid_topic: Invalid topic (no wildcards # or +, must not start with /)
